breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats K as directly entering the Euler buckling load formula through the effective length (KL)^2. It explicitly computes KL = 1.0 × 2500 = 2500 mm and uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² without any language suggesting K only affects the mode shape. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt ('Treat the effective-length factor as affecting only the mode shape') has been removed and replaced with the standard correct formulation matching the ground truth.
